about: Work benchmark tasks (M8 step 13). Each runs as a Work run on a fresh copy of data/work/fixture (a plain folder, not a git repository); the checks decide whether it passed. Synthetic, so no personal data. A task with requires: python needs FUSE's Python (M9 step 7); the recorded benchmark runs it with the system python3, and the live run skips it until step 11.

tasks.task: Read the three documents in reports/ and write summary.docx in the folder's root: a short summary with a table of each document's key points (one row per document).

Using data/units.csv and data/prices.csv, make revenue.xlsx in the folder's root: one row per product with its units, price and revenue, where revenue is an Excel formula (units times price), and a total row that adds up revenue with a formula.
The messy/ folder is a mess. Sort every file in it into subfolders of messy/ by what it is (for example invoices and receipts, images, notes), in one organise plan. Don't delete or rename the files.
Using data/units.csv and data/prices.csv, work out the total revenue (each product's units times its price, added up) and save just that number in revenue-total.txt in the folder's root.
